topic.title: Accessing
topic.shortdesc: How to access the Cloud platform main page and organization workspaces.

body.p: The Cloud service is available at:
This page represents the platform main page. From here, users can create new organizations, or sign up/log in to the organizations they belong to.
Once you know your organization, you can access the organization workspace in two ways:

li.p: By selecting the organization from the platform main page.
By accessing the organization-specific URL directly.

body.p: The organization URL has the following form:
where orgid is the unique identifier of that organization.

p.note: Bookmark your organization-specific URL in your browser for quick access in the future.

body.p: Users can belong to multiple organizations. However, authentication is handled separately for each organization, so you will need to sign up and log in to each organization you want to access.
